name: Bailey
description:
This wig has a soft, dimensional level 9/8 blonde look with a natural shadowed root. The color blends beige and sandy blonde tones with subtle darker lowlights throughout, giving it depth without looking overly contrasted. The face framing pieces are bright and flattering, while the overall finish stays soft, neutral, and luxurious.

The hair is long, sleek, and straight with a smooth blended finish and a natural center part. Overall, it gives a polished, expensive blonde look with plenty of dimension.
